resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Vietnamese source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Vietnamese pass identified 25 actionable terminology, grammar, formula-notation, circuit, thermal, and SI-unit defects; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Vietnamese human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The zero-resistance warning used a literal unit-first phrase.
evidence: The previous text was Điện trở bằng 0 Ω.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as resistance of 0 Ω and retained the short-circuit warning.

findings.summary: The limits paragraph translated non-ohmic behavior as components not being ohms.
evidence: The previous paragraph used thành phần ... không phải là ohm.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it as components not necessarily obeying Ohm's law.

findings.summary: The heating paragraph used công suất nhiệt where the source concept is heat capacity.
evidence: The previous paragraph used Công suất nhiệt và mật độ dòng nhiệt.
findings.resolution: Changed it to nhiệt dung and heat-flux density.

findings.summary: The Kirchhoff description did not name charge and energy as conserved quantities.
evidence: The previous description did not explicitly state conservation of charge and energy.
findings.resolution: Named charge conservation at nodes and energy conservation around closed loops.

findings.summary: The KCL example used an awkward literal sentence for current leaving a node.
evidence: The previous paragraph used dòng điện ... dẫn ra and literal direction wording.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with natural Vietnamese node-current terminology.

findings.summary: The KVL paragraph used a literal translation for voltage rises and drops.
evidence: The previous paragraph used a literal algebraic-sum construction.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with consistent Vietnamese terms for voltage rise, drop, loop direction, and polarity.

findings.summary: The resistor-equation step used less direct relation wording.
evidence: The previous bullet used a literal relation phrase.
findings.resolution: Changed it to liên hệ điện áp và dòng điện qua điện trở bằng V = I × R.

findings.summary: The TCR current equation localized I as a Vietnamese pronoun.
evidence: The previous expression was Tôi = V/R.
findings.resolution: Restored the protected equation I = V / R.

findings.summary: The TCR units omitted conventional spacing around division.
evidence: The previous bullet used 1/°C and ppm/°C.
findings.resolution: Normalized the units to 1 / °C and ppm / °C.

findings.summary: The TCR worked-example title was a literal activity phrase.
evidence: The previous title was Ví dụ hoạt động.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Ví dụ tính toán.

findings.summary: The TCR limitation paragraph used a literal phrase for material-property changes.
evidence: The previous paragraph used thay đổi vật liệu and a literal first-order comparison.
findings.resolution: Clarified material-property changes and deviation from the first-order estimate.

findings.summary: The right-triangle paragraph misdescribed sine, cosine, and tangent relationships.
evidence: The previous text said sin đối diện với cạnh huyền and used incorrect tangent wording.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the side definitions and SOH-CAH-TOA ratios.

findings.summary: The triangle example title translated side as a generic side/party term.
evidence: The previous title was Tìm một bên.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Tìm một cạnh.

findings.summary: The angle-mode paragraph was less natural than standard Vietnamese technical instructions.
evidence: The previous paragraph used a literal mode-of-angle construction.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with natural wording for degree/radian mode and a full turn.

findings.summary: The heat-capacity heading used a literal phrase for basic relationships.
evidence: The previous heading was Các mối quan hệ cơ bản.
findings.resolution: Retained the clear technical wording and normalized the heading for the locale.

findings.summary: The water-heating setup needed consistent Vietnamese number and unit formatting.
evidence: The previous setup omitted standard spacing around degree units and used a less consistent specific-heat number.
findings.resolution: Normalized the setup to 20 °C, 70 °C, and 4.180 J/(kg·K).

findings.summary: The electrical-heating heading used a literal warming phrase.
evidence: The previous heading used a literal translation of electrical heating.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Gia nhiệt bằng điện.

findings.summary: The heat-flux description omitted the density/per-area meaning.
evidence: The previous description began Dòng nhiệt mô tả.
findings.resolution: Changed it to mật độ dòng nhiệt and explicitly stated each unit of area.

findings.summary: The heat-flux summary did not state the per-area quantity directly.
evidence: The previous summary used a literal through-one-area phrase.
findings.resolution: Changed it to tốc độ truyền nhiệt trên một đơn vị diện tích.

findings.summary: The convection paragraph called h a surface coefficient and used imprecise radiation wording.
evidence: The previous paragraph used hệ số bề mặt and a literal radiation term.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the convection coefficient, emissivity, and absolute kelvin temperatures.

findings.summary: The SI table heading did not identify the entries as base units.
evidence: The previous heading was Các đơn vị SI phổ biến.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Các đơn vị cơ bản SI.

findings.summary: The kilo prefix was not presented with the standard Vietnamese SI prefix form.
evidence: The previous prefix cell used the generic translated form.
findings.resolution: Changed it to kilo.

findings.summary: The wire-gauge description used generic wording and did not clearly state that the named system is required.
evidence: The previous description was a literal nominal-size statement.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it to say that the gauge system must be specified.

findings.summary: The wire-gauge section heading was less specific than the standard Vietnamese term.
evidence: The previous heading used a generic measuring-system phrase.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Hệ thống cỡ dây.

findings.summary: The wire-dimension instruction used an awkward literal phrase for bare and insulated dimensions.
evidence: The previous bullet used a literal list of conductor, insulated diameter, sheet, and tube-wall dimensions.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it with clear Vietnamese engineering terms.
